text:
zoe: opened a small PR to merge the structured-output examples into the function-calling migration doc: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

paul: nice! quick request: can we include a concise validator schema and a tiny runtime parse pattern for both JS and Go? helps integrators.

matt: also saw one doc that uses `tool_id` and `toolName` in different spots. i'd like us to standardize on `tool` across all examples.

lisa: agreed on `tool`. suggested shape: include an optional `meta` object for routing hints, and allow `args` to be object or array. paste a minimal schema below for copy/paste.

zoe: drop it in, thanks.

lisa: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tool": {"type": "string"},
    "args": {"oneOf":[{"type":"object"},{"type":"array"}]},
    "meta": {"type":"object"},
    "confidence": {"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}
  },
  "required":["tool","args"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

paul: good. can we also show a concrete tool enum for a `url_fetch` example so readers see required fields?

matt: here's a compact variant for that: ```json
{
  "type":"object",
  "properties":{
    "tool":{"type":"string","enum":["url_fetch","redis_get"]},
    "args":{
      "oneOf":[
        {"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string"}},"required":["url"]},
        {"type":"array"}
      ]
    }
  },
  "required":["tool","args"],
  "additionalProperties":false
}
```

zoe: perfect. i'll add both schemas to the PR and collapse older `function_call` examples into a short compatibility section. suggested sentence: "Map legacy `function_call.name` -> `tool` and `function_call.arguments` -> `args` (object or array)."

paul: add a parsing snippet for Go too, since infra teams use it. minimal example: ```go
resp := client.Generate(ctx, req)
var payload map[string]any
json.Unmarshal([]byte(resp.Output), &payload)
if payload["tool"] == "url_fetch" {
  args := payload["args"].(map[string]any)
  fetch(args["url"].(string))
}
```

matt: nit: add a callout that `confidence` is advisory and not calibrated. link to /guides/evals for guidance.

lisa: also our snippet linter flagged one missing backtick fence in the PR diff; fixed that in a tiny commit. ci will re-run.

ci-bot: CI: docs lint + snippets check for PR #512  2 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)  https://ci.internal/redwood/512 :white_check_mark:

paul: one more operational ask: there's an external-facing path `/sdk/js/tooling` that other teams link to. the migration doc currently references `/sdk/js/old-tooling` which will 404. do we add a redirect?

zoe: yes i'll open a second tiny PR to _redirects.yml and ping marketing.

matt: who wants final review after these tweaks? i'm free in the afternoon.

lisa: i'll do a final pass and look for any leftover `toolName`/`tool_id` instances. will tag you, matt.

zoe: thanks all. target to merge by tomorrow morning. will ping when the redirect PR is up. :rocket:
